description: This file contains a class `AmazonAgentCoreConfig` that provides configuration and utility methods for interfacing with Amazon Bedrock's AgentCore API, including request transformation, response parsing (JSON and SSE), and environment validation. It handles authentication, request URL construction, response parsing, streaming support, and error handling, specifically tailored to Amazon Bedrock's AgentCore model integration.

classes.name: AmazonAgentCoreConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore API interactions, providing URL generation, request signing, request transformation, response parsing (including SSE), streaming, and error handling tailored to Amazon Bedrock's API.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns an empty list since AgentCore does not support OpenAI-compatible parameters.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps provided OpenAI params to AgentCore-specific parameters; here it returns the optional_params unchanged.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for invoking the AgentCore runtime, including ARN encoding and optional qualifier as query parameter.

methods.name: Tuple[dict,Optional[bytes]] sign_request( self, headers: dict, optional_params: dict, request_data: dict, api_base: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, stream: Optional[bool] = None, fake_stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Signs the request either via Bearer token (Cognito/JWT) or AWS SigV4, returning headers and body.

methods.name: str _get_agent_runtime_arn(self, model: str)
methods.description: Extracts the ARN string from a model identifier of format 'agentcore/<ARN>'.

methods.name: str _extract_region_from_arn(self, arn: str)
methods.description: Parses the AWS region from an ARN string.

methods.name: str _get_runtime_session_id(self, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a runtime session ID, ensuring it exceeds 33 characters.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_runtime_user_id(self, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime user ID if provided.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms input messages into a payload for AgentCore, setting session and user headers.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] _extract_sse_json(self, line: str)
methods.description: Extracts JSON data from an SSE 'data:' line.

methods.name: Optional[AgentCoreUsage] _extract_usage_from_event(self, event_data: Dict)
methods.description: Extracts usage metadata from an event container.

methods.name: Optional[str] _extract_content_delta(self, event_data: Dict)
methods.description: Extracts text delta content from event data.

methods.name: str _extract_content_from_message(self, message: AgentCoreMessage)
methods.description: Concatenates text blocks from a message object.

methods.name: Optional[Usage] _calculate_usage( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], content: str )
methods.description: Uses a token counter utility to calculate token usage for prompt and response.

methods.name: AgentCoreParsedResponse _parse_json_response(self, response_json: dict)
methods.description: Parses JSON response from AgentCore to extract content and message.

methods.name: AgentCoreParsedResponse _get_parsed_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response )
methods.description: Determines response type (JSON or SSE) and parses accordingly.

methods.name: AgentCoreParsedResponse _parse_sse_stream(self, response_text: str)
methods.description: Parses SSE stream text into content, usage, and message.

methods.name: AgentCoreSSEStreamIterator get_streaming_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, )
methods.description: Returns an iterator over streaming SSE responses.

methods.name: CustomStreamWrapper get_sync_custom_stream_wrapper( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_base: str, headers: dict, data: dict, messages: list, client: Optional[Union[HTTPHandler, "AsyncHTTPHandler"]] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, signed_json_body: Optional[bytes] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a synchronous custom stream wrapper for streaming responses.

methods.name: CustomStreamWrapper get_async_custom_stream_wrapper( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_base: str, headers: dict, data: dict, messages: list, client: Optional["AsyncHTTPHandler"] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, signed_json_body: Optional[bytes] = None, )
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous custom stream wrapper for streaming responses.

methods.name: bool has_custom_stream_wrapper(self)
methods.description: Indicates support for custom streaming wrappers.

methods.name: bool supports_stream_param_in_request_body(self)
methods.description: Indicates that `stream` cannot be passed in request body; streaming is inferred from response format.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Parses and transforms AgentCore responses (JSON or SSE) into the standard ModelResponse format, including token usage data.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Performs environment validation; here it simply returns headers.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns a BedrockError exception with provided message and status code.

methods.name: bool should_fake_stream( self, model: Optional[str], stream: Optional[bool], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Indicates whether to fake streaming behavior, always true for this class.
